Helper settings must retain export defaults without erasing capture preferences; catalog must distinguish missing audio.
Audio matching must exclude unrelated browser/app/microphone streams; export paths must preserve originals.
Scope is the local QML/helper/recorder pipeline; no game network protocol or remote sync changes.
PipeWire stream lifecycle and GSR input attachment determine whether clips contain game audio.
Settings, filename and destination controls require labels, keyboard access, focus and visible errors.
Regression proof must cover route recovery, decoded audio, trim/export preservation and native UI.
Retain the existing native media-player structure while exposing track and export state.

Ibara isolated native fixture verifies settings and export dialog keyboard behavior; fresh human capture verifies audible sound in Clips and external player.
